english.title: Operator permit UK aircraft to fly for public transport without being satisfied in relation to routes and aerodromes
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of an aircraft registered in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), permitted it to fly for the purpose of public transport without first being satisfied using every reasonable means that the aeronautical radio stations and navigational aids serving the intended route or any planned diversion were adequate for its safe navigation
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 115 and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
